title: Open-Meteo historical archive — Courmayeur 45.791N 6.969E, 13–19 September 2015–2025
claims: The query returns 77 daily records for 13–19 September in each year from 2015 to 2025 at the requested Courmayeur coordinates 45.791N / 6.969E.
The API returns the model grid point 45.729N / 7.098E with a grid elevation of 1,174 m, which differs from the requested point.
Daily maximum temperature across the 77 days ranges from 9.7°C to 28.6°C, with a median of 19.6°C.
Daily minimum temperature across the 77 days ranges from −1.7°C to 13.5°C, with a median of 9.6°C.
33 of the 77 days record at least 1 mm of precipitation and 14 record at least 5 mm, with a maximum daily total of 24.0 mm.
The values are modelled historical data for a valley grid point, not measurements on the course or at the passes.
